acceptanceCriteria: A1: v0.2.27 version, distribution documentation, tri-language parity, and release workflow policy are internally consistent before release verification.

A3: the public v0.2.27 artifact is downloaded and verified by adopter and upgrade acceptance with no source, workspace, or local-target fallback.

goal: Release v0.2.27 and bind its public artifact identity for post-release adopter and self-governance acceptance.
intent: Publish v0.2.27 from merged main with the hermetic governance fixture correction, then validate the immutable public Release artifact and install it for repository governance.
outOfScope: Moving, overwriting, or reusing immutable failed release history
